title: A draining cone changes its surface at a different rate
stem: Water occupies a cone whose radius r is half its depth h. The volume decreases at 2 cubic centimetres per second. At one instant h=4 cm.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the rate of change of h at that instant.

parts.label: b

steps.text: The negative sign means the exposed circular surface is shrinking.

title: A costed cylinder does not have equal height and diameter
stem: An open cylindrical tank has volume $500\pi$ cm$^3$. Its base costs 3 units per cm$^2$ and its curved wall costs 1 unit per cm$^2$. Ignore thickness.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the total cost can be written in terms of radius r as C=3πr²+1000π/r.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the radius giving minimum cost and express the corresponding height in terms of r.

steps.text: $C^{\prime\prime}(r)=6\pi+2000\pi/r^3>0$ for r>0, so the stationary point is the unique global minimum.

title: Two tangents from a point below a parabola
stem: Two tangents are drawn from P=(0,−4) to the parabola y=x².

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find both tangents and their points of contact.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the area enclosed by the two tangents and the parabola.

steps.text: Passing through P requires −a²=−4, so a=±2.
The tangents are y=4x−4 at (2,4) and y=−4x−4 at (−2,4).

diagramCaption: Original mathematical diagram. Use exact values stated in the question; do not measure the drawing.
answerSummary: The tangents are y=4x−4 at (2,4) and y=−4x−4 at (−2,4). The area is $16/3$ square units.

title: A sliding ladder accelerates downward
stem: A ladder of length 10 m rests against a vertical wall. Its foot moves away from the wall at a constant 0.5 m s$^{-1}$. Let x be the foot’s distance from the wall and y its height.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: When x=6, find y and its rate of change.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the downward acceleration of the top at that instant.

steps.text: Differentiate $x\dot x+y\dot y=0$: $\dot x^2+\dot y^2+y\ddot y=0$, since $\ddot x=0$.
The negative acceleration means the downward speed is increasing.
